g.text: Test relevance, coverage and restrictive filters
Bridgewater’s reported retrieval comparison is specific; it does not establish answer quality or alpha.

g.text: Reported internal benchmark: ~200 labeled questions; precision@10 ~60% → 90–95%.
The speaker corrects “recall” to precision. No held-out design, uncertainty or investment result is supplied.
Test sparse time/source/asset filters, no-evidence cases and required-source coverage before compression. Then inspect retained meaning, omissions and human review effort in the final brief.
